title: Sources & further reading
body:
Primary/official sources checked directly for this guide: Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026 official announcement · Japan MOFA — visa exemption · Japan Tourism Agency — tax-free system change, Nov 1 2026 · JR Kyushu Rail Pass · JR Hokkaido — scenic tour trains · JR East — Suica/PASMO sales status · Seven Bank — foreign-card ATM access · Zao Ropeway — operating season · Federal Reserve H.10 — JPY/USD reference rate.

Also checked directly: JNTO — Matsushima · JNTO — Jigokudani, Noboribetsu · Visit Miyagi — Naruko Gorge · Shin Shin ramen, Tenjin · Ganso Nagahamaya · Ganso Motsunabe Rakutenchi · Fukuya mentaiko, Nakasu · Animate Fukuoka · Animate Sapporo · Animate Sendai · jozankei.jp — official autumn hiking trails · Zao Town tourism association · Ubigi Japan eSIM rates · Yamato Ta-Q-Bin · Sapporo Beer Museum — rain plan_b for Mt. Moiwa · Otaru Music Box Museum — rain plan_b for Otaru · Yumoto Sagiriyu — rain plan_b for Jigokudani · SHIKAnoYU day-use onsen — rain plan_b for Jozankei.

Secondary/community leads (used to find the above, never cited as fact on their own): Fukuoka Now (resident magazine), Yahoo Chiebukuro local Q&A threads, Visit Miyagi and Tohoku Kanko regional tourism sites, japan-guide.com, watabi.org's 2026 koyo forecast roundup, and assorted r/JapanTravel-adjacent forum/blog discussion. Facts carried forward from an earlier pass on this same trip kept their original verification dates where unchanged; the Zao Ropeway closure assumption was corrected against the operator's own page, and the domestic-flights/Shinkansen-fare misattribution was separated into distinct sourced rows.

Every fact above carries its own source and checked date inline in the section it appears in — this list is a jumping-off point for your own pre-trip re-checks, not a substitute for the per-section citations.
